summary:
App: Excalidraw (production build of excalidraw-app), a hand-drawn whiteboard loaded with the seeded "Ledgerline · Platform planning board" scene. Saved 5 views, and all replayed with similarity 1.00:
1. board-overview: the whole board zoomed to fit (Shift+1). It shows all the frames (architecture, roadmap, ERD, sprint kanban, checkout flowchart, retro, archive) plus the toolbar, zoom/undo controls and help.
2. shape-properties: zoomed in on the Checkout v3 frame (click the frame title, then Shift+2) with a flowchart shape selected, so the full style properties panel is open.
3. main-menu: the hamburger menu open, with file and export actions, collaboration, command palette, help, preferences, theme, language and canvas background.
4. export-image: the Export image dialog, with a preview of the scene, toggles, scale and PNG/SVG/clipboard buttons.
5. command-palette: the searchable command palette with grouped commands and their shortcuts.

Replay notes: every view starts from goto /#url=/seed/... . Each one presses Escape (and the later ones press it twice) and then Shift+1. This is because my own browser showed a "Load from link / replace your content" dialog and kept a saved selection and zoom. In a fresh browser these key presses do nothing, so all views start from the same zoomed-to-fit state.

Not captured: the library sidebar, which starts empty; the Share/collaboration dialog; and the help/shortcuts dialog. I left them out because I had already used all 5 views on the screens above.
